definitions.meaning: A story of praise, panegyric, eulogy

quotations.old_english: Gehýr nú þis herespel (the story of creation)

source_text: here-spel. v. hér. Substitute: here-spell, es; n. A story of praise, panegyric, eulogy :-- Gehýr nú þis herespel (the story of creation), Sch. 37. Cf. here-word.
